prompt: Build a small CLI that watches a directory and notifies via webhook when a markdown file changes

primary.target: CLI tool that watches a directory and sends webhook notifications on markdown file changes

secondary.target: directory watcher for filesystem change events
change events to markdown files only (.md extension)
HTTP POST webhook payload on detected markdown change
CLI arguments for directory path and webhook URL
webhook payload schema (file path, event type, timestamp)
errors for invalid directory, unreachable webhook, or permission issues
secondary.dependency: core watcher and webhook sender implemented

secondary.target: language and filesystem-watch library (e.g. Node/chokidar, Python/watchdog, Go/fsnotify)

assumptions: webhook endpoint URL is user-supplied at runtime
markdown files are identified by .md extension
notification means HTTP POST to the webhook URL
'small' implies minimal dependencies and single-file or minimal-file implementation
watching is continuous/persistent until process is killed

artifacts: cli entry point (e.g. watch-md.js / watch_md.py / main.go)
package manifest if needed (package.json / requirements.txt / go.mod)

east.text: CLI watches a target directory for .md file changes and notifies an external system via webhook
User invokes CLI with directory path and webhook URL as arguments
Webhook payload should communicate what changed and when

south.text: Select language and appropriate filesystem-watch library
Determine webhook payload schema: file path, event type (created/modified/deleted), timestamp
Investigate debounce needs — rapid saves could fire multiple events for one logical change
Decide whether directory watching is recursive or top-level only

west.text: Test watcher detects .md changes and ignores non-.md files
Validate webhook POST is sent with correct payload on change
Verify graceful error output for missing directory or unreachable webhook

north.text: Implement CLI argument parsing (directory, webhook URL)
Implement directory watcher filtering for .md files
Implement HTTP POST webhook sender with JSON payload
Wire watcher events to webhook sender
Add basic error handling and user-facing console output

actionStack.text: Choose implementation language and filesystem-watch library
Define CLI interface: required args (directory, webhook-url), optional flags (recursive, debounce-ms)
Define webhook POST payload schema (path, event, timestamp)
Implement directory watcher with .md file filter
Wire change events to webhook sender
Add error handling for bad directory path and webhook failures
Test .md change detection and webhook delivery end-to-end
Verify non-.md file changes are ignored

ambiguities.suggestion: Clarify preferred language; Node.js (chokidar) or Python (watchdog) are common minimal choices
Confirm expected payload: at minimum { path, event, timestamp } as JSON

ambiguities.text: Recursive vs. top-level directory watching unspecified
ambiguities.suggestion: Clarify whether subdirectories should be watched; default to recursive for most use cases

ambiguities.text: Which change events to notify on — created, modified, deleted, renamed?
ambiguities.suggestion: Assume all events by default, or confirm if only 'modified' is wanted

ambiguities.text: Debounce behavior unspecified — editors often write files multiple times per save
ambiguities.suggestion: Add optional debounce flag (e.g. --debounce 300ms) to avoid duplicate webhook calls
